cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

mechanism: A grants corrections as if supervising a familiar setup, applying each clue about poles and fabric without admitting the initial mistakes.
confusable: Generic confidence can ignore evidence; D42 requires observable learning from the clues even while familiarity is performed.
comparison: Tent assembly before rain differs from coffee serving controls and guest customization.
seedUse: Use D42-b clips and inner-tent correction, with S01 approval turning helpful teaching into ostensibly supervised execution.
